name: metalcore

chord_progressions.source: Melodic clean chorus — relative-minor form of vi-IV-I-V (Riffhard chorus guide)
Phrygian verse riff — open low-string pedal with b2 tension
Breakdown — open-string tonic pedal, rhythm carries the section

song_sections.name: intro
song_sections.note: Clean/ambient guitar or filtered riff, full band slams in on the last bar

song_sections.name: verse
song_sections.note: Screamed vocals over palm-muted riffing and double kick

micro.name: A
micro.note: Main riff, chugs locked to the kick

micro.name: B
micro.note: Riff variation, building toward the pre-chorus

song_sections.name: pre-chorus
song_sections.note: Open chords ring out, drums lift to the cymbals

song_sections.name: chorus
song_sections.note: Clean sung hook over open power chords — the 'good cop' half

micro.name: B
micro.note: Hook repeat, lead harmony on top

song_sections.name: break
song_sections.note: Breakdown: half-time, open-string chugs locked to the kick, snare on beat 3

micro.name: chug
micro.note: Syncopated chug pattern on the tonic

song_sections.name: outro
song_sections.note: Final breakdown or a ringing chord with feedback

principles: Low-tuned (drop C / drop B) palm-muted power-chord riffing in minor/Phrygian — the b2 and open-string tonic pedal carry the heaviness
Double-kick and thrash-beat drumming at 130-170 BPM in verses, opening to a backbeat with cymbals under the chorus
Good cop / bad cop contrast — screamed, riff-driven verses vs. a clean, melodic chorus over i-VI-III-VII
Half-time breakdown as the climax — kick locked to the guitar chugs, snare on beat 3, space between hits
research_sources: https://metalcoredeathcorehardcoregrindcore.fandom.com/wiki/Breakdowns?oldid=3972 (breakdowns: open low strings, drop D-drop B, half-time, snare on 3, kick follows chugs)
https://www.riffhard.com/?p=37226 (clean melodic chorus after heavy verse; I-IV-V / vi-IV-I-V)
https://guitarmasterclass.net/ls/Killswitch-Engage-Style2 (KsE-style lesson: drop B, B minor, 120 BPM)
https://eprints.soton.ac.uk/496107 (breakdown treated as a distinct formal section)

sound_design.notes: Quad-tracked rhythm guitars hard-panned; bass DI + distorted layer; china/crash chokes on breakdown hits; optional string/synth pad under choruses.

notes: Breakdown is encoded as top-level 'break' (the schema has no 'breakdown' section). Its density is set below 0.4 so drums.py picks the lowest-energy (half-time) pattern. Drum patterns are 16-step.
